mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Orders ( user_Idx, total_Price, receiver, delivery_Phone, address, Extra_Address, Zipcode, order_Date, status ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{totalPrice}, #{receiver}, #{deliveryPhone}, #{address}, #{extraAddress}, #{zipcode}, NOW(), 0 )

INSERT INTO OrderItems ( order_Idx, product_Idx, category, subCategory, product_Name, price, discount_rate, color, size, quantity, product_main_img, status ) VALUES ( #{orderIdx}, #{productIdx}, #{category}, #{subCategory}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{color}, #{size}, #{quantity}, #{productMainImg}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT oi.item_Idx AS itemIdx, oi.order_Idx AS orderIdx, oi.product_Idx AS productIdx, oi.category, oi.subCategory, oi.product_Name AS productName, oi.price, oi.discount_rate AS discountRate, oi.color, oi.size, oi.quantity, oi.product_main_img AS productMainImg, (SELECT review_Idx FROM Reviews WHERE item_Idx = oi.item_Idx AND is_hide = 0) AS rIdx FROM OrderItems oi WHERE oi.order_Idx = #{orderIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE Orders SET total_Price = #{totalPrice}, receiver = #{receiver}, delivery_Phone = #{deliveryPhone}, address = #{address}, extra_Address = #{extraAddress}, zipcode = #{zipcode} WHERE order_Idx = #{orderIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT order_Idx AS orderIdx, user_Idx AS userIdx, total_Price AS totalPrice, receiver AS receiver, delivery_Phone AS deliveryPhone, address AS address, Extra_Address AS extraAddress, Zipcode AS zipcode, order_Date AS orderDate, status AS status FROM Orders WHERE order_Idx = #{orderIdx}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_Date, '%m') as MONTH, SUM(total_Price) as TOTAL_SUM FROM Orders WHERE DATE_FORMAT(order_Date, '%Y') = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY MONTH
SELECT order_Date, order_Idx, CONCAT(address, ' ', Extra_Address) AS address, total_Price FROM Orders WHERE user_idx= #{userIdx};

SELECT oi.product_Idx, oi.product_name, oi.color, oi.size, oi.quantity, CASE WHEN oi.discount_Rate > 0 THEN oi.price * (1 - discount_Rate / 100) ELSE oi.price END AS finalPrice, r.review, r.rating, r.is_Hide FROM OrderItems oi LEFT JOIN Reviews r ON oi.Item_Idx = r.Item_Idx WHERE order_idx = #{orderIdx};

SELECT oi.status, o.order_Date, o.order_Idx, oi.item_Idx, o.receiver, o.delivery_Phone, CONCAT(o.address, ' ', o.Extra_Address, '(', o.zipcode, ')') AS fullAddress, oi.product_Name, oi.size, oi.color, oi.quantity FROM Orders o JOIN OrderItems oi ON o.order_Idx = oi.order_Idx
ORDER BY o.order_Idx desc limit #{startIdx}, #{pageSize}
SELECT count(*) as totalCount from Orders o JOIN OrderItems oi ON o.order_Idx = oi.order_Idx
